image_description: A close-up, high-contrast image of a cooked Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) positioned centrally against a dark background. The crab is viewed from the ventral side (underside), displaying its folded abdomen and leg joints. The carapace is visible at the top, showing reddish-orange coloration typical of cooked crustaceans. The legs are splayed, with prominent claws featuring red tips and white/cream segments. There appears to be some glossy reflection on the shell, indicating moisture or oil.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection points where the legs meet the body are poorly defined. Several leg segments appear to melt into the central abdominal plate rather than attaching via distinct joints. This structural ambiguity is a common AI artifact in complex jointed creatures.
The legs on the left side seem to fade out or terminate abruptly without clear endpoints. It is unclear if there are full 5 pairs, suggesting missing or incomplete limb generation.
The texture is overly uniform and plastic-like in areas, lacking the micro-texture of a real crustacean shell. It looks more like rendered plastic than biological calcified material.
The tip of the right claw appears slightly deformed and blunt, lacking the sharp, defined pincer structure. It looks somewhat melted or compressed.
